hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'git (commit|push)' && [ "$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" = "main" ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Direct commits/pushes to main are not allowed. Create a feature branch first.' >&2; exit 2; fi

FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '"file_path":\s*"[^"]+"' | sed 's/.*"\([^"]*\)"$/\1/' | head -1); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && uv run ruff check "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | head -5 || true; fi
